title: Agent worktrees, changes, review and CI
summary: A clean branch and a successful check do not by themselves mean a release.

claims.text: Git worktrees provide distinct working directories associated with one repository. DiagramCloud CI can package evidence even when earlier checks fail because selected steps use always().

levels.overview: Follow one task from isolated work to reviewed integration.
levels.architecture: Separate repository identity, local worktree, branch/ref, source commit, CI run and artifact.
levels.detail: Inspect exact SHA, dirty changes, check outcome, artifact digest and integration ownership.

example.input: Two synthetic agents touch overlapping paths in separate worktrees.
steps: Use one integrator and inspect the actual merged source checks.
example.output: A reviewable integration path, not an automatic merge.
limits: A worktree is not a security sandbox.
Commit authorship is not automatically agent authorship.

alternatives.label: One sequential writer
alternatives.whenToConsider: Consider when changes share sensitive paths.

alternatives.label: Independent worktrees
alternatives.whenToConsider: Consider for bounded independent candidate work with one integration boundary.

interview.question: How would you prove which code a CI result qualifies?
answerHints: Bind the result to its exact source revision.
Check the merged source separately where needed.

instanceMappingPolicy: An explicit source-pinned link is required; names, icons and tags are not evidence.
